description: This file defines the GrainAddress class, which represents an address for a grain within Orleans. It includes properties like GrainId, ActivationId, SiloAddress, and MembershipVersion, as well as methods for equality comparison and string representation.

classes.name: GrainAddress
classes.description: Represents an address in Orleans, containing identifiers for the grain, its activation, the silo hosting it, and the membership version.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if this GrainAddress is equal to another object or GrainAddress based on GrainId, ActivationId, and SiloAddress.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Determines if two GrainAddresses match based on SiloAddress, GrainId, and ActivationId considerations.

methods.name: MatchesGrainIdAndSilo
methods.description: Static method to check if two GrainAddresses have matching GrainId and SiloAddress.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on SiloAddress, GrainId, and ActivationId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the GrainAddress.

methods.name: ToFullString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string including MembershipVersion.

methods.name: NewActivationAddress
methods.description: Creates a new GrainAddress for an activation given a silo and grain, generating a new ActivationId.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Static method to construct a GrainAddress with specified silo, grain, and activation identifiers.
